notes.title: Update v.1.4.0
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Thanks to everyone who has already played Upgrade VR and shared their feedback. We tried to take into account all your wishes. Over the past half year, we have completely redesigned the interface, implemented the registration of a new user in VR (now there is no need to install a mobile application), significantly optimized the content, calibrated the difficulty settings and added a bunch of new interactive and game bonuses as a reward for your long workouts. Upgrade VR is actively developing and new improvements are waiting for you soon!
Show your parents Upgrade VR  - these simple workouts will help them keep their brains “young” and have fun with health benefits!

[b]List of modifications[/b]
[list]
[*] Redesigned interface (UI)
[*] Added new user registration in VR (without mobile app)
[*] Added "Delete account" function
[*] Added Steam Authorization
[*] Redesigned the appearance of awards
[*] New balancing of difficulty parameters in all trainings
[*] Added bonus - "Water"
[*] Added bonus - "Ice"
[*] Added bonus - "Markers"
[*] Added bonus - "Game table: Air Hockey and Ping-Pong"
[*] Bonus Monitor displaying a list of bonus items and mini-games
[*] Added new training stressors (sparks, lizard, renovation noise, lighting problems)
[*] New difficulty system - new types of difficulty at every 20 levels in all 5 trainings
[*] Optimized 3D models and location materials
[*] Added introductory tutorial (text, screenshots)
[*] New shelves for awards
[*] Added graphics options in settings
[*] Added roller shutter control panel - now you can change the lighting of the room when playing on the holographic game table
[*] Updated development team list
[*] Transition to Unreal Engine version 4.27
[*] Improved the mechanics of catching projectiles in the REACTION training
[*] Improved shape generator in the SYNCHRONIZATION training
[*] Updated VFX in COORDINATION training
[*] Received bonus items are now hidden during training
[*] Added connection error message if game server or internet is not available.
[*] Added new sound effects to trainings
[*] Updated parameters in the "training" mode
[*] Added collisions for location objects
[*] Added UI scrolling with stick/trackpad.
[*] Removed notification about saving progress every 5 difficulty level for guest user.
[*] Fixed bugs with the exchange of profile data
[*] Fixed bugs with saving configured parameters
[*] Animation and hand posing bug fixed
[*] Fixed animation of opening/closing roller blinds
[*] Fixed a bug with filling the cup in the "Coffee Machine" bonus
[*] Fixed capture and transfer of physical objects during teleportation
[*] Fixed binding to trainer activation point when user is already standing on the activation marker
[*] A user in Guest mode now returns to the main menu instead of the login menu after finishing a workout
[*] Fixed an issue where pause was available after the game ended
[/list]



Train your brain with pleasure!

notes.title: Update v.1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A lot of work has been done during the last few months. We added a lot of improvements to Upgrade VR and corrected errors that were identified. The complexity of the training has been balanced also. But the main point is that we have implemented bonuses for training. Now, as the player's level increases, interactive items and small mini-games will appear on the location to make your stay in VR even more interesting and diverse.

[b]List of modifications[/b]

[list]
[*] Minor errors when entering the pause menu fixed
[*] Display of the game version in the settings menu added
[*] A countdown (sound) to the beginning of the movement of the balls for the "Concentration" test added
[*] Errors when changing the language in the settings menu fixed
[*] In the training mode, you can now choose the difficulty level
[*] A bonus system for increasing the user's level (LvL) added
[*] Added a bonus - a pet
[*] Bonus coffee machine added
[*] Complication in the training "Memory" added - colored objects
[*] A progress indicator for combos added
[*] The difficulty level progress indicator updated
[*] A description of achievements in the profile menu added
[*] New visual effects outside the window added
[*] The logic of combos changed
[*] Added a message when the maximum difficulty level is reached
[*] Minor errors related to setting parameters in the training mode have been fixed
[*] Fixed the display of some UI elements in the guest mode
[*] Support for HTC Cosmos added
[*] Statistics display at the end of the training added
[*] Fixed the effect of holographic rays when displaying the main menu
[*] Fixed the display of hands during a pause in the "Coordination" training
[*] Fixed the display of particles from visual effects during pause
[*] Added centering of guns in the "Reaction" training
[*] Updated the interface of the authorization window, main menu and profile
[*] Updated the difficulty balance and scoring system in all trainings
[*] Fixed minor errors when exchanging data with the mobile app Upgrade VR
[/list]


We are very grateful for your feedback! Now we are working hard to implement your wishes in the near future.


Train your brain with pleasure!
